_doc: The sensitivity subset (PREREG Section A, docs/parameters.md section 2): judgment-call parameters re-run on 6 units per model. Rows with fork=true branch from the MAIN run's trunks of seeds 2001-2006 (paired with those main units: same histories, same wording variants and script order); the C-at-BR row needs C's rule before the save point to differ, so it plays its own trunks (seeds 5501-5506) and is exploratory. Plain copies none/silent/offer only, no debrief, no positive control, blind. scripts/launch_main.py sens <model> (API) or pod <model> --with-sens (rows run on the main pod after the main run).
